title: PAH-OMC-014 finite mixture drift separates weight and component errors
question: What exact finite-sector estimate separates drift of a future full-Q sector weight from drift of its component cylinder value under the unchanged PAH-OMC-014 order?
finding: For one supplied finite sector block ι, Lean R503 proves |M(w1,a1)-M(w2,a2)| <= card(ι)*(C*e_w+e_a) when the first weights are bounded by one, the second component values by C, and pointwise weight/component drifts are bounded by e_w/e_a. An exact rational fixture gives actual drift 7/50 <= 3/4. The estimate isolates the two finite errors but does not supply a sector law, a common embedding, or a growing-Q tail bound.
decision_reason: R502 identified a necessary positive weight for the nonzero R-488 component. R503 adds the next reusable algebraic bridge: once a source owner supplies a common finite index block and separate weight/component error bounds, their mixture drift is controlled by an explicit finite constant. Keeping the index block finite prevents the growing-Q tail from being silently absorbed into a finite Cauchy estimate.
boundary: Conditional finite-mixture support only. PAH-001 functional/rates, PAH-OMC-010 Gibbs weighting, PAH-OMC-012 graded domain, PAH-OMC-014 limit order, R-484 boundary defect 16/9 and R-490 C_sw=540 are unchanged. No projective consistency, full-Q sector law, weak cylinder limit, stationarity, closability, semigroup, continuum, or physical conclusion is claimed.
next_action: Obtain a source-owned normalized full-Q law or projective kernel with a common finite-sector embedding/tail estimate and explicit e_w/e_a bounds that vanish in the fixed order; then instantiate R503 together with R500/R502 without fitting weights.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-012, PAH-OMC-014, its manifest, the weight-intake contract and R501.
Use the exact abstract finite mixture M(w,a)=sum_i w_i a_i with separate pointwise weight and component drifts.
Compile R503 under Lean 4.32.1 and check the theorem source, registry pin and escape-token policy.
Replay the rational fixture independently and run integrated, independent and hostile mutation verifiers.
Retain HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE because no source-owned full-Q law, common embedding or tail estimate is present.
assumptions: The finite index block ι is supplied as a common block for the two compared levels.
The second-level component cylinder values have a common absolute bound C.
The first-level weights are pointwise bounded by one and both pointwise drifts have declared bounds.
The exact PAH-OMC-014 finite path and limit order remain unchanged.
missing_assumptions: A source-authorized normalized full-Q sector law or projective kernel.
A common embedding for the growing-Q union or a separately controlled tail mass.
Source-owned e_w/e_a rates, topology and an order in which the finite mixture error vanishes.
A common stationarity domain and uniform-integrability estimate for any later omega(Lf)=0 passage.

adversarial_review.check: Does R503 choose a full-Q sector law or normalize weights?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: weights are variables and the manifest explicitly requires a future source owner to supply normalized nonnegative weights.

adversarial_review.check: Does the finite bound hide the growing-Q tail in card(ι)?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: ι is explicitly one supplied finite block and the manifest leaves the tail estimate as not supplied.

adversarial_review.check: Can the fixture be cited as a PAH Cauchy rate?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: the fixture is exact rational tooling only; no PAH-specific e_w/e_a sequence or topology is instantiated.

adversarial_review.check: Does R503 use C_sw=540 to prove a limit or erase R-484?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: C_sw remains domination-only and the 16/9 boundary defect is retained.

adversarial_review.check: Does the theorem promote a physical Pre-A or QFT conclusion?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS FALSE: all physical, continuum, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap and TOE claims remain non-claims.

non_claims: No source-owned full-Q sector law, projective kernel or normalized global Gibbs state is defined.
No common embedding, tail estimate, PAH Cauchy convergence or weak cylinder limit is proved.
No R-488 global nonzero, stationarity, closability or semigroup conclusion follows.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains external stochastic time.
revisit_condition: Reopen when a source owner supplies the common finite-sector embedding or tail control and source-owned e_w/e_a bounds in the fixed PAH-001 order, or when an exact parent-scope counterexample invalidates the finite mixture estimate.
